name: Shift Block
description: Three enamel slabs refuse to share an edge. The red one keeps the beat.

name: Two Plate Offset
description: Fluorescent pink and teal miss each other on purpose. The overlap is the print.

name: Phosphor Hold
description: A green reticle waits on a dead monitor. The raster still believes in work.

name: Tide Cut
description: A block of cream paper takes the tide in carved strokes. Nothing here blends.

name: Seed Field
description: A meadow that is only dots. The bloom walks; the ground never draws a line.

name: Proof Sheet
description: A construction that never became a building. The white line is still deciding.

name: Torn Stack
description: Four leftover sheets refuse a tidy stack. One scrap keeps leaving the pile.

name: Interference
description: Two ring families argue in black and white. The moiré is the only subject.

name: Hold Still
description: A night that refuses a subject. The grain is the only thing that moves.

name: Tube Script
description: A glyph that is only glass and gas. The current travels; the word never arrives.

name: Pressed Leaf
description: A specimen plate with no garden behind it. The midrib darkens as the press holds.

name: Trace Board
description: A board with no device. Gold pads wait. One trace finally takes current.

name: Nine Patch
description: Nine fabrics share a seam allowance. The center square keeps inhaling thread.

name: Calcite
description: A slab of stone with nothing carved into it. The veins keep changing their mind.

name: Night Plate
description: A catalog of lights with no myth attached. The plate turns a few degrees and stops.

name: Tesserae
description: A wall of glass squares with no picture in mind. Light crosses them anyway.

name: Rime
description: Ice writes a tree on cold glass. The growth is the drawing.

name: Plume
description: Pigment forgets it had an edge. The rise is slower than smoke and thicker than air.

name: Lockup
description: One letter takes the whole chase. The impression deepens; the alphabet stays out of it.

name: Fold Plane
description: A sheet that has already been thought through. One valley keeps changing its mind.

name: Hatch Dune
description: A map of a place that is only height. The wind rewrites the contours.

name: Lead Light
description: Jewel glass held by lead. No glow, no wash — only a pane that changes its mind.

name: Punch
description: A card that stores nothing you can read. The holes advance; the meaning stays out.

name: Wet Bloom
description: Water gets there first. Pigment follows and refuses a border.

name: Sampler Row
description: A counted cloth that never learned a picture. One row of X’s keeps arriving.

name: Lino Bite
description: A block of linoleum keeps one animal. The beak advances a cut at a time.

name: Teletype
description: A roll of unused language. The cursor is the only reader.

name: Kintsugi
description: A bowl that was already broken. The gold is the only part still deciding.

name: Waybill
description: A label for a package that never left. The scan line is the journey.

name: Instant Peel
description: A photograph that refuses a subject until the chemistry finishes. It never quite does.

name: Ben-Day
description: Four cheap inks pretending to be a sky. The cyan plate keeps arriving late.

name: Ikat Shift
description: A warp that was tied before it was dyed. The miss is the pattern.

name: Tape Window
description: A cassette that never plays a song. The reels keep the only motion.

name: Bitten Plate
description: Acid remembers every circle. The plate darkens where the bite holds.

name: Yield Field
description: A sign with no road. The warning is the whole landscape.

name: Sand Ring
description: A mandala made to be swept. One ring turns before the broom arrives.

name: Carbon Copy
description: A second sheet keeps a letter no one mailed. The words slip one row.

name: Barricade
description: A road closed to nothing. The stripes keep walking anyway.

name: Urushi
description: Many coats of night. A red thought shows only when the light is wrong.

name: Radar Sweep
description: A scope that keeps a storm that is not there. The arm is the weather.

name: Pennant Line
description: Flags that name no ship. One pennant keeps changing its mind in the wind.

name: Microfiche
description: A library reduced to amber. One row of ghosts advances.

name: Garter Knit
description: A scarf that is only rows. The needle is still working the last one.

name: Slate Dust
description: A blackboard with no lesson. The dust keeps a stroke that will not stay.

name: Encaustic
description: Wax poured over a thought. The thought keeps trying to surface.

name: Cork Pins
description: A board that never held a note. The pins keep finding new holes.

name: Cell Pour
description: Acrylic that decided to become a map. The cells breathe without blending.

name: Staff Walk
description: A measure with no key. The note keeps the appointment anyway.

name: Flemish Bond
description: A wall that is only the wall. One brick remembers weather.

name: Thermograph
description: A temperature with no body. The hot spots keep changing their address.
